_comment: The exact Hugging Face snapshot of every local model the measurements used. A rerun
pins to these (reproduce.py), because the example configs name a model, not a revision,
and a fresh machine would otherwise download whatever is served today.
Taken from the snapshot each committed run recorded. Two runs predate that recording
(the fabriceyhc fine-tunes, revision 'unavailable' in their fingerprints); their entries
are the commit REFERENCE.md cites, which is also each repository's latest commit, unchanged
since 2021-09-21 -- so it is the only revision those runs could have downloaded.
`self_test` checks this table against every committed run and against REFERENCE.md.
_safetensors_comment: What a RERUN loads for five models whose measured revision is a pickle (pytorch_model.bin).
Loading a pickle runs code, and torch < 2.6 refuses these outright; each model has a
safetensors conversion PR on the Hub, pinned here by commit. docs/evidence/
conversion_pr_check.py ran every one through its arm's own adapter: byte-identical outputs
on every item checked; and on 2026-10-15 each was rerun through reproduce.py on this table
and scored identically to its committed run on every item (200/200, 280/280). `revisions`
above stays the record of what was measured; reproduce.py prefers this table. bart_s is
absent on purpose: its conversion is fp16 and matches only 19 of 20 cast to fp32.
